question: Should `openclaw skills install <bundled-name>` provide bundled-skill guidance locally, or should bundled names gain explicit trusted ClawHub package mappings?
rationale: Current OpenClaw ships three reported names locally, while ClawHub correctly cannot select among colliding community publishers without an explicit trust decision.

options.title: Bundled-name guidance
options.body: Detect bundled names and likely typos in OpenClaw, explain local availability or prerequisites, and reserve ClawHub installation for owner-qualified references.

options.title: Trusted ClawHub mappings
options.body: Assign explicit official owner-qualified packages for selected bundled names and resolve only those maintained mappings.

options.title: Marketplace-only errors
options.body: Keep the command marketplace-only and improve the raw 404/409 output to require `@owner/slug`.

recommendation.title: Bundled-name guidance
recommendation.body: Detect bundled names and likely typos in OpenClaw, explain local availability or prerequisites, and reserve ClawHub installation for owner-qualified references.

likelyOwner.reason: Their work defines the ClawHub collision boundary and provides the strongest routing signal for coordinating the cross-repository contract.
